title: Ending epilogue says of Vell: 'They walked with you to the end still not saying what Marrowgate means to them.' But Vell explicitly and at length told the player the secret at the Highward record-house ('I'm Marrowgate's own blood, exiled before I could walk... I'd rather you heard it from me than the throne', plus a follow-up about standing outside the palace once and not going in). The epilogue reads as if the confidence was never shared, when it plainly was.
